question:
Seven boxes A, B, C, L, X, Y and Z are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only four boxes are kept between A and Z. Only B is kept above A. Only two boxes are kept between L and Y. C is kept immediately above X. Y is not kept immediately above C.

Which box is kept fourth from the top?
solution:
